summary: Frontend-only validation of metadata/SEO/social pass for Relais IT single-page site. All SEO meta tags, OG, Twitter cards, JSON-LD ProfessionalService, favicon/og-image assets, html lang=fr, accessibility (single H1, alt text), WhatsApp float and Contact section structure verified on the public preview URL. No visual regressions, no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: About section uses id="apropos" (matches French nav link). Review request casually referred to it as 'about' but actual id is 'apropos' and the nav 'À propos' link works correctly — no fix needed.
Smooth-scroll CTAs/nav links use programmatic scroll (no URL hash update). This is fine UX-wise; element is correctly scrolled into viewport.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEO/metadata pass fully validated via DOM inspection on public preview. Asset endpoints (favicon.ico, favicon.png, apple-touch-icon.png, og-image.png, manifest.json) all return 200. Single H1 confirmed: 'Votre partenaire IT de confiance'. JSON-LD parses as ProfessionalService with name 'Relais IT'. WhatsApp float at data-testid='whatsapp-float' opens https://wa.me/2250747732557 (target=_blank, aria-label set). Contact section has 0 forms, 3 info cards (contact-telephone/email/localisation), 3 action buttons (contact-call-btn/email-btn/whatsapp-btn). Section card counts: services=6, solutions=3, apropos=3, pourquoi=6, formations=3.
